clauses.text: Each party shall bear its own legal fees and expenses incurred in connection with the negotiation and drafting of this Agreement.
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party without cause.
The failure of either party to enforce any provision of this Agreement shall not be construed as a waiver of future enforcement of that or any other provision.
All notices required under this Agreement must be delivered in writing via certified mail or electronic mail to the designated corporate address.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of law principles.
If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.
Neither party shall issue any public press release regarding this commercial relationship without the prior written consent of the other party.
The parties are independent contractors, and nothing herein shall be construed to create a partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship.
Customer may request additional user licenses at the then-current pricing rate via written addendum executed by both authorized representatives.
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties superseding all prior oral or written understandings regarding the subject matter.
Vendor reserves the right to modify, alter, or completely change these terms of service at any time without prior notice to the customer, and continued use constitutes binding acceptance.
Customer grants Vendor an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free, worldwide license to use, modify, and commercialize all proprietary customer data and derived algorithms for any purpose.
In the event of any contractual dispute, Customer agrees that Vendor's chosen executive officers shall serve as the sole and binding arbitrator with final unappealable authority.
Vendor's total aggregate liability for any claim arising out of this agreement shall be strictly limited to the total fees actually paid by Customer in the preceding seven days.
Customer agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Vendor against any and all claims, losses, or regulatory fines resulting from third-party actions completely unrelated to Vendor's software.
Upon any minor billing delay, Vendor reserves the immediate right to remotely disable, lock, or brick the customer's enterprise environment without judicial process or notice.
Customer is strictly prohibited from deploying, testing, or utilizing any competing software or analytical tooling for a period of five years following contract termination.
All intellectual property, custom configurations, and source code generated during the engagement shall automatically vest solely in Vendor, with no residual rights retained by Customer.
Vendor may unilaterally increase annual subscription fees by up to fifty percent (50%) at each contract renewal cycle without requiring customer sign-off or consent.
Customer explicitly waives any right to trial by jury or participation in class action litigation against Vendor, accepting mandatory binding arbitration in an offshore jurisdiction.
